title: Alembic CI runs without the environment variable its runner actually reads
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:141-152 sets only RLS_TEST_DATABASE_URL; apps/api/alembic/env.py:30 reads DATABASE_URL or sqlalchemy.url
note: RLS CI job will fail at alembic upgrade head because no connection URL is set.

title: Alembic env converts asyncpg URL to sync dialect but uses async_engine_from_config
evidence: apps/api/alembic/env.py:31-34 replaces postgresql+asyncpg with postgresql, then :62-66 uses async_engine_from_config
note: Asymmetric handling: either keep async URL or use sync engine.

title: CI uses plain postgres:15 image; supabase policies require auth.jwt() and service_role
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:127-135 starts postgres:15; supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:32 calls auth.jwt() and lines 109-112 target role service_role
note: Need Supabase Postgres or pre-create auth.jwt() + service_role role.

title: RLS tests connect as PostgreSQL superuser which bypasses RLS
evidence: tests/rls/test_tenant_isolation.py:18,30-32 uses postgresql://postgres:postgres@...
note: Postgres superuser bypasses RLS even with FORCE. Must connect as non-superuser non-bypassrls role.

title: Simulated JWT context is discarded because SET LOCAL is issued outside a transaction
evidence: tests/rls/test_tenant_isolation.py:32-36 SET LOCAL without BEGIN
note: SET LOCAL has no durable effect outside explicit transaction. Need BEGIN or conn.transaction().

title: UPDATE and DELETE rejection assertions misunderstand PostgreSQL RLS behavior
evidence: tests/rls/test_tenant_isolation.py:113-118,135-138 expect InsufficientPrivilegeError
note: RLS USING policy makes invisible row → UPDATE 0 / DELETE 0, not exception. Tests would always fail.

title: RLS test data is never cleaned up and uses globally unique static emails
evidence: tests/rls/conftest.py:106-129 inserts a@example.com and b@example.com on every fixture
note: Second test violates users.email UNIQUE. Need cleanup or random emails.

title: with_service_role never acquires or activates a service-role identity
evidence: apps/api/core/service_role.py:91-103 gets ordinary session; never uses supabase_service_role_key, SET ROLE, or service-role JWT
note: Helper only writes audit, doesn't actually establish service-role context for the action.

title: The claimed audit-first commit guarantee is false; successful wrapper calls are rolled back
evidence: apps/api/core/service_role.py:102-106 only flushes, says 'caller commits'; lines 123-136 claim audit committed BEFORE action but no commit before action
note: When session closes, uncommitted audit and action writes are rolled back. Spec requires committed audit before action.

title: Service-role lint job will reject current story files
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:111-116 rejects 'service_role' outside core/service_role.py; but apps/api/core/settings.py:43 has supabase_service_role_key, apps/api/core/audit.py:6 documents service_role
note: Lint will fail CI on these false positives. Need to either broaden lint pattern or rename the strings.

title: FastAPI dependency never publishes tenant identity to the SQLAlchemy listener
evidence: apps/api/core/tenant_context.py:52-62 only stores request.state; lines 119-130 define set_tenant_local/clear_tenant_local without callers
note: Listener ContextVar remains unset, so RLS sees no tenant and returns 0 rows for all queries.

title: SQLAlchemy begin event callback has wrong signature and wrong connection API
evidence: apps/api/core/tenant_context.py:104-112 registers _begin_transaction(dbapi_connection, transaction) and calls dbapi_connection.cursor()
note: Engine begin event supplies single SQLAlchemy Connection (sync) — different from DBAPI. Async version needs async_engine listeners.

title: Tenant GUC cannot serve documented fallback because no RLS policy reads it
evidence: apps/api/core/tenant_context.py:72-75 claims app.current_tenant_id fallback; supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:30-136 only reads auth.jwt() -> app_metadata
note: current_setting fallback claim is dead code unless policies are updated to read it.

title: AuthError has no FastAPI exception handler; AD-15 responses are not produced
evidence: apps/api/core/security.py:33-47 defines AuthError as Exception; apps/api/main.py:11-39 only registers /health and startup
note: AuthError raised by dep will result in 500, not AD-15 contract {code, message_ko, details, trace_id} HTTP 401.

title: JWT validation omits issuer, audience, and token-type binding
evidence: apps/api/core/security.py:91-98 only sets algorithms/leeway/require=['exp']
note: No iss/aud/typ validation. Signed tokens from another context are accepted.

title: JWT error details expose internal decoder implementation names
evidence: apps/api/core/security.py:105-110 returns {reason: type(e).__name__}
note: Library exception names like InvalidAudienceError leak to clients.

title: emit_audit does not validate all required audit invariants
evidence: apps/api/core/audit.py:26-33 accepts actor_id=None and reason=None
note: Spec requires non-null. Allows service_role_bypass records without actor or reason.

title: Database does not enforce service-role audit completeness
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:112-121 makes actor_id and reason nullable; supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:109-112 uses WITH CHECK (true)
note: Direct service-role insert can create bypass record without actor/reason — DB doesn't enforce AD-2 completeness.

title: Audit append-only trigger conflicts with audit tenant foreign key
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:114 tenant_id ON DELETE SET NULL, lines 130-151 reject UPDATE
note: Deleting referenced tenant tries to set tenant_id NULL via FK, which is an UPDATE on audit_logs, which the trigger rejects. So tenants cannot be deleted.

title: tenant_memberships.role has no enum-like CHECK constraint
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:79-86
note: Arbitrary role strings can be persisted. Need CHECK (role IN ('owner','member','viewer')).

title: Membership FKs do not prevent cross-tenant user attachment
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:81-85 references tenants and users independently
note: Tenant-A membership can reference tenant-B user. Need CHECK (user.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id) or composite FK.

title: Tenant-settings JSONB namespaces have no JSONB indexes
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:96-99 JSONB columns, no GIN indexes in :155-168
note: Onboarding/baseline queries will be slow. Need GIN indexes on each namespace.

title: settings_version accepts invalid zero and negative versions
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:95 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, no CHECK
note: Undermines version-checked settings aggregate contract.

title: Same-tenant RLS policies grant every JWT role same mutation scope
evidence: supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:52-63,70-81,88-99 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE without role predicate
note: Viewer and member can mutate same-tenant users, memberships, settings.

title: Owner policies are broader than spec and redundant under permissive policy composition
evidence: supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:114-136 FOR ALL for owner
note: AC #2 says owners can READ all members, not manage. Generic policies already allow mutations.

title: Audit-log reads are not restricted to owners despite the policy comment
evidence: supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:101-105 comment says 'Reads by tenant owner' but checks only tenant equality
note: Every same-tenant role can read audit trail.

title: RLS policy deployment is not idempotent
evidence: supabase/policies/0001_rls_policies.sql:30-136 bare CREATE POLICY without DROP POLICY IF EXISTS
note: Re-running deployment fails. Need DROP POLICY IF EXISTS or DO block.

title: RLS smoke test can pass with policies missing from specific tables
evidence: supabase/policies/0002_rls_smoke_test.sql:18-24 checks only policyname, ignores schemaname/tablename/command/roles/qual
note: Test passes vacuously. Need per-table, per-policy check.

title: Service-role audit tests never exercise a database, RLS, persistence, or the append-only trigger
evidence: tests/rls/test_service_role_audit.py:2-3 pure unit tests, lines 98-115 use AsyncMock/MagicMock
note: Cannot establish that audit row is present immediately before a real privileged write (per AC #5 last clause).

title: Documented Supabase migration path references a non-existent file
evidence: apps/api/alembic/versions/0001_tenants_users_memberships_settings.py:11-13 claims DDL mirrored in supabase/migrations/0001_platform_tenants.sql; supabase/README.md:29-31 claims supabase db push applies
note: No supabase/migrations file exists. supabase db push is for raw SQL only, not Alembic.

title: CI artifact step does not upload test results
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:166-175 runs pytest without JUnit output, uploads .pytest_cache and __pycache__
note: No actionable test-result artifacts uploaded.

title: Stack partially unpinned outside the documented Pydantic exception
evidence: pyproject.toml:35-37 import-linter>=2.0; apps/api/pyproject.toml:29-31 hatchling unversioned
note: AD-14 requires exact pins only. Minor.

title: Pydantic core workaround is confined to dev extras, not production dependencies
evidence: apps/api/pyproject.toml:7-15 pydantic-settings runtime without core constraint; lines 17-23 puts pydantic>=2.10,<2.12 + pydantic-core==2.27.2 in [dev]
note: Production wheel without dev extras can resolve a different (broken) pydantic-core.
